title: The finite-module tensor-to-completed-constant comparison
statement: Let X be a scheme, A a commutative Noetherian ring, I an ideal, C its adic completion, and H the inverse limit of the constant quotient ring sheaves A/I^(n+1). Let phi: constant(C) -> H have completion evaluations as all finite projections. For every finite C-module N there is an isomorphism, over constant A, from H tensor_(constant C) constant N to the inverse limit of constant(N/I^(n+1)N). These isomorphisms are natural in C-linear module maps on every quotient projection. They are linear for completed scalars in the projection sense: if a constant A-section a and a completed scalar r have the same n-th residue, the n-th projection of e_N(r x) equals a times that of e_N(x). This asserts neither exactness of the realization functor nor local lissity. All realization, scalar and quotient-module maps are those of [def-weil-pbc-completed-constant-realization-data].

proof.text: Construct the compatible canonical quotient projections for every completion module, with their pure-tensor, scalar-linearity and module-map naturality identities. Form the comparison map by the limit universal property.

For each finite completion module use invertibility of this fixed comparison map to form asIso. Its composites with limit projections are the previously constructed finite projections. Rewrite the two requested formulas with this equality, then use their proved scalar-linearity and naturality identities.

proof_origin.description: Construct the canonical finite projections and their identities first; reduce only invertibility of the resulting specified map to the finite-presentation tensor-limit calculation in Stacks 0912 and 093J--093M.

mathlib_searches.query: For a finite module over the adic completion of a Noetherian ring, scalar extension of its constant sheaf to the completed constant ring sheaf is naturally the limit of its constant quotients
mathlib_searches.results: AdicCompletion.ofTensorProductEquivOfFiniteNoetherian and related ordinary-module theorems; none includes constant sheaves or their sheafified scalar extension.

mathlib_searches.query: Scalar extension from the constant adic completion ring to its completed constant sheaf realizes finite modules as the inverse limit of constant quotient module sheaves and is exact
mathlib_searches.results: AdicCompletion.map_exact, ofTensorProductEquivOfFiniteNoetherian and ordinary completion module instances; no sheaf comparison.
AdicCompletion.ofLinearEquiv and ofAlgEquiv concern ordinary completed modules, not sheafified tensor realization.

theorem completed_constant_finite_module_comparison (X : Scheme.{u})
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (φ : adicLisseConstantRing X (AdicCompletion I A) ⟶ adicLisseCompletedRing X I)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, φ ≫ limit.π (adicLisseRingSystem X I) (op n) =
      (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1}).map
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (AdicCompletion.evalₐ I (n + 1)).toRingHom)) :
    ∃ e : ∀ (N : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AdicCompletion I A))
        (_hN : Module.Finite (AdicCompletion I A) N),
      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars ((adicLisseForget X).map
        (completedConstantBaseMap X I φ))).obj
          ((completedConstantRealization X I φ).obj N) ≅
        adicLisseCompletedModule X I (completedConstantUnderlyingModule I N),
      (∀ (N : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AdicCompletion I A))
          (hN : Module.Finite (AdicCompletion I A) N) (n : ℕ) (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ)
          (r : ((adicLisseCompletedRing X I).obj.obj U))
          (a : (adicLisseConstantRing X A).obj.obj U)
          (x : ((completedConstantRealization X I φ).obj N).val.obj U),
        ((constantSheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1}).map
          (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))).hom.app U a =
            (limit.π (adicLisseRingSystem X I) (op n)).hom.app U r →
        (limit.π (adicLisseModuleSystem X I (completedConstantUnderlyingModule I N))
          (op n)).val.app U ((e N hN).hom.val.app U (r • x)) =
          a • (limit.π (adicLisseModuleSystem X I (completedConstantUnderlyingModule I N))
            (op n)).val.app U ((e N hN).hom.val.app U x)) ∧
      (∀ (M N : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AdicCompletion I A))
          (hM : Module.Finite (AdicCompletion I A) M)
          (hN : Module.Finite (AdicCompletion I A) N) (f : M ⟶ N) (n : ℕ)
          (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : ((completedConstantRealization X I φ).obj M).val.obj U),
        (limit.π (adicLisseModuleSystem X I (completedConstantUnderlyingModule I N))
            (op n)).val.app U ((e N hN).hom.val.app U
              (((completedConstantRealization X I φ).map f).val.app U x)) =
          (((adicLisseConstantModules X A).map (completedConstantQuotientMap I
            ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion I A))).map f)
              n)).val.app U)
            ((limit.π (adicLisseModuleSystem X I (completedConstantUnderlyingModule I M))
              (op n)).val.app U ((e M hM).hom.val.app U x)))
